objective: Calibrate the fixed number of causal spatial predecessors used by the support entropy model on the same 50 exposed HEST development slices used for value-group selection, with value K fixed at 32 and all physical archive costs paid.
primary_endpoint: Sum of full physical archive bytes over all 50 slices for each fixed spatial M candidate; ROW_M06 is diagnostic and cannot be selected as the spatial default.
selection_rule: Among spatial M candidates compute 100*(candidate_bytes-minimum_bytes)/minimum_bytes; candidates at or below 0.05 percent are tied and the smaller M is selected. Leave-largest-saver-out removes the single most negative per-slice byte delta versus M6 before re-summing. Report per-slice wins, median paired change and platform/species/organ descriptive strata.
allowed_changes: New isolated experimental codec wrapper and dynamic support-context implementation
Reuse hash-verified K32 value members without changing them
forbidden_changes: Modify historical archives or Production Shared source
Change value K=32, value context, magnitude classes, support bucket edges, probability precision, metadata, source order, or coordinates
Call the selected M universally optimal
Treat ROW_M06 as a spatial candidate
acceptance_criteria: A frozen preflight reproduces the K32 anchor support stream and support odds byte-for-byte for SPATIAL_M06.
All 400 planned archives are physically written and independently decoded in fresh processes.
Counts, dtype, shape, ordered spot/gene identities, coordinates and contract metadata match exactly.
Every archive ledger reconciles exactly to physical file size and unchanged value members match the K32 anchor hashes.
All failures and retries are retained; no sample replacement.
Independent review has no unresolved P0/P1 finding.
One separately produced archive matches the main archive byte-for-byte.
